Newsletter Oktober 2023

Dear members,

We hope everyone has had an amazing holiday and kick-off. With this we would like to welcome you all back to another great year of blueshell! 

 

Yours truly,

The 7th board 

 

 

 

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • Cobo
  • Kick-in
  • Kick-off
  • What is coming up in October
  • New Esports teams
­

Blueshell CoBo

Hey there member of Blueshell!

Coming thusday we will celebrate our new board with a cobo! 

 

The 7th Blueshell board consists of:
Reinout Strating - Chairman
Max Jansdam - Secretary and Commissioner lounge affairs
Jesse van Gameren- Treasurer and Commissioner Esports affairs
Mitchell van Poecke - Commissioner internal affairs 
Sanne van Kooten- Commissioner external affairs


We invite you to our constitution drink which takes place on Thursday the 5th of October at 20:00 in the Predator Esports Lounge. The location will be: Bastille, De Hems 10, 7522 NL Enschede.

 

The first keg of beer will be free! (There will also be a bottles of free soda). 


Because of the location we will not be able to permit brassing.


Hope to see you there, 
The 7th board

­

Kick-in 

The year started off well with the kick-in. We even had a Do group: Redshell! Here are some pictures from it.

Upcoming in October

The Weekly gamenights organised by the board start this month. Make sure to come by the lounge and have a drink (They might not all be listed below, but are every monday).

Committee market will be this month, so if you are planning on joining a committee be sure to be there :) 

­

Esports

The scouting grounds with ETT are done and our new teams for Academy League have taken form. So let me give a short introduction 

 

Rocket League

BS Turtles

Back and renewed. Ready for another season of Academy League!

BS Oogway

The wisest of the our previous players made a team with a name to show it.

BS Squirtles

A fun team made with both old and new people from the scouting grounds. Team Rocket (League)

BS Tadpoles

A team of new players ready to play and grow to new hights.

 

League of Legends 

BS Scaling

They are back and still scaling. Ready to dominate another bracket of Academy League.

 

BS Housecats

Our newest LoL team is ready to show off their skill in Academy League.

 

Valorant

Bs Tempra

Tempra is our new team from scouting grounds! Filled with enthusiastic new players, ready to make a name for themselves under the name of Blueshell.

SpicyWater and IcyWater

While originally planning on being one inexperienced for fun team, they got enough members to create a second team and so they did.

 

CounterStrike 2

HyperS

HyperS is back! But now in Counterstike 2. 

-Jonas 

+Joran and Marijn
